#kutupae yuklemesi yayptım
library(tidyverse)
library(e1071) 

students <- read_csv(file.choose())

#Soru3:
ogrenciler<-read_csv("students.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
S1 <- ogrenciler %>% 
  select(Age, Gender, MathScore,ScienceScore, PassedMath)
S1_filtered <-S1 %>% 
  filter(Age > 16, PasssedMath == "Yes")

#Soru 4:

ggplot(ogrenciler,aes(x = MathScore, y = ScienceScore, color = Gender)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
  x = "Matematik Notu"
  y = "Fen Bilgisi Notu"
  title = "Matematik ve Fen Notları Ilıskisi",
  color= "Cinsiyet"
)+
theme_minimal()

#Soru 5:

math <- ogrenciler$MathScore
istatistikler <- tibble(
  Minimum = min(math,na.rm = TRUE),
  Maksimum = max(math,na.rm = TRUE),
  Ortalama = mean(math,na.rm = TRUE),
  Medyan = median(math,na.rm = TRUE),
  q1=quantile(math, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
  q2 = quantile(math, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
  IQR =IQR (math, na.rm = TRUE),
  Carpıklık = skewness(math, na.rm = TRUE),
  Basıklık = kurtosis(math, na.rm = TRUE)
)
istatistikler
